---

### Scope
Market, platform, category, affected section, and whether this is law, policy, conservative practice, or style guidance.

### Official source
URL, title, applicable provision, effective date if available, and access date.
If login is required, include a permitted excerpt or redacted screenshot and mark the access limit.

### Proposed change
Explain the current error and safer wording. Include an affected input/output example.
